title: The 1787 text forbids a religious test for federal office
summary: The 1787 text forbids a religious test for federal office.
body: Article VI of the 1787 transcription says no religious test shall ever be required as a qualification for any office or public trust under the United States. The source says: "s Constitution; but no religious Test shall ever be required as a Qualification to any Office or public Trust under the United States." The sentence is about a test for office. It is not the later amendment on establishment and free exercise.

sources.title: The Constitution of the United States: A Transcription
